findings.issue: Claimed the trade-deal shortfall 'gives Congress cover for more' US listing actions; no own-date headline supports a congressional role.
findings.resolution: Reworded to say the shortfall adds to Washington's list of grievances (interpretive, no new fact).

findings.issue: 'so the entry is not crowded' asserted positioning/ownership with no headline or card field (ASHR -4.04% over 20 sessions does not establish crowding).
Used the collapsed Nvidia-Arm deal as evidence that platforms are funding consolidation; the headline shows a regulatory failure, so the inference ran backwards.
findings.resolution: Rewritten: Microsoft weighing Mandiant versus a deal blocked by regulators; no new facts.

findings.issue: Santander ceasing US mortgage origination was read as evidence that higher rates are the cause; headline gives no reason.
findings.resolution: Softened to a non-causal observation about origination exposure; word count kept within 150-200.

findings.issue: 'The consensus fears windfall taxes' presented an unsupported consensus; BBC headline only explains the windfall tax.
findings.resolution: Reworded to 'Windfall taxes are the visible policy risk'.

findings.issue: 'Pricing is running ahead of input costs' not supported by DuPont/Sherwin headlines.
findings.resolution: Replaced with 'Price increases are sticking in reported results' (DuPont headline cites price hikes).

findings.issue: Attributed Peloton's 25.28% jump solely to restructuring; same draft attributes the five-session +33.01% to takeover talk (BBC n0651).
Asserted the Qualcomm 'high bar' has reset lower for equipment names; speculative.
findings.resolution: Made conditional (may have reset / could be rewarded).

findings.issue: Czech-rates-twice-Poland headline (3 Feb) predates the 8 Feb hike, so the gap was stated as still current.
findings.resolution: Qualified as the gap before Tuesday's hike.

findings.issue: 'defensive yield name' for Orange Polska had no support.
'finance minister replaced over a tax reform' cited only the new-minister headline, not the Polityka headline that ties the minister to Polski Ład.

Checked citation support, source naming, timing (all items before cutoff; company results within 14 days, news within 7, macro within 35), all card numbers/horizons/units, 20-observation curve wording, absence of numeric spot-FX, FB ticker usage, guardrail events (NBP, Peloton, Nvidia-Arm, Pfizer, BP, SoftBank, Bitfinex treated as known; Disney/Uber/Toyota results, Glapinski conference and US CPI treated only as pending). No fatal or major issue found; no cross-date contamination detected (every number found in the own-date card or same-part headline).

scope_limits: Own-date feed, card and BRIEF only; headlines not article bodies. Could not verify actual release times beyond headline stamps; CBA (n0069) used as a pre-open 9 Feb AEDT release, i.e. before 00:00 UTC. n1349 (Abu Dhabi Ports debut) relies on its 8 Feb stamp. Spot-FX absent so not checked.

exclusion_rebinds.reason: Root added editorial exclusions for uncited records after review; reviewed component content unchanged.
